name: death-right
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT RIGHT PROFILE faces screen-RIGHT. Exactly FOUR COMPLETE death/corpse poses in FOUR EQUAL QUADRANTS of a 2x2 square grid, preferably 1536x1536. Each whole pose centered in its quadrant, with AT LEAST 100px transparent margin on every side, NEVER crosses the central horizontal/vertical dividing axes. Reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Frame1 upright zombie reels facing RIGHT, knees buckle, standing anatomical height about400px. Frame2 low kneeling slump facing RIGHT. Frame3 falls forward to RIGHT onto near side, head atRIGHT shoes atLEFT. Frame4 motionless corpse lies FLAT, headRIGHT shoesLEFT, same side/face/chest visible, limp hands near head. Same anatomy/scale across allframes; flat corpse LOWER/WIDER and maximum450px long, never enlarged to standing height. Keep full hands/head/boots separated from all other frames by a WIDE blank gutter. No floor, pool, effects, ghost or resurrection.
